protocol.parity: corpus, graph, and posting digests plus file, node, edge, and resolved-call counts compared per pair
protocol.readiness: restore or mutation return, before the registered Cypher, word, trigram, and literal queries; ready_and_queries adds those queries, so a reader blocked by background work is counted
protocol.regime: quiet host: CI idle; each trial waited for 0.9 idle CPU over three seconds and must keep external load at or under 0.25 busy cores

superseded_measurement: An earlier run of 579dce1ff7, before the review fixes, encoded under the index lock: its first queries after publication took about 0.33 s, so readiness alone overstated the gain. These trials replace it.
